UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user's payment and verification profile (isolated to owner).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

upiId.description: User's UPI VPA for receiving settlements.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

SharedVerificationRecord.title: SharedVerificationRecord
SharedVerificationRecord.description: Two-party verifiable Udhaar ledger record readable only by the two participants.

creatorUid.description: UID of the user who created and shared the record.

counterpartyUid.description: UID of the counterparty who confirmed or disputed the record (empty string until claimed).

participantUids.description: Bounded 1-2 element array of participant UIDs used for two-party read/query isolation.

lenderName.description: Canonical name of the lender (GIVEN party).

borrowerName.description: Canonical name of the borrower (TAKEN party).

creatorRole.description: Whether the creator recorded this entry as GIVEN or TAKEN.

startDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the loan start date.

expiryDateMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the due date, or -1 if open-ended.

contentHash.description: 64-character SHA-256 hex digest of canonical party, amount, currency, dates, type, and interest terms.

verifiedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when confirmed/verified, or -1 if unverified.

attachmentRefs.description: Bounded list (<= 5) of end-to-end encrypted attachment references.

isSettled.description: Whether the record is marked settled.

SharedPartialPayment.title: SharedPartialPayment
SharedPartialPayment.description: Installment payment recorded on a shared verification record with counterparty acknowledgement.

recordedByUid.description: UID of the party who recorded the installment.

recordedByName.description: Display name of the party who recorded the installment.

participantUids.description: Denormalized 1-2 participant UIDs for flat security rule evaluation.

isAcknowledged.description: Whether the other party confirmed/acknowledged this installment.

acknowledgedByUid.description: UID of the party who acknowledged this installment.

SharedAuditEvent.title: SharedAuditEvent
SharedAuditEvent.description: Immutable append-only audit trail entry for a shared verification record.

actorUid.description: UID of the user who triggered the event.

participantUids.description: Denormalized 1-2 participant UIDs for two-party read isolation.

contentHashSnapshot.description: SHA-256 contentHash at the time of the event.

acknowledged.description: Whether the counterparty acknowledged this event.

eventTimeMillis.description: Client event timestamp in epoch milliseconds.

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: In-app communication thread per transaction or per party, with typing status, mute, block, and report controls.

threadId.description: Unique thread ID (e.g., tx_<remoteId> or party_<key>).

threadScope.description: Whether this thread is scoped to a specific transaction or a general party thread.

remoteRecordId.description: Associated remote transaction ID when threadScope is TRANSACTION, or empty string.

creatorUid.description: UID of the user who initialized the thread.

counterpartyUid.description: UID of the counterparty on the thread (or empty string before claimed).

participantUids.description: Bounded 1-2 element array of participant UIDs.

typingUid.description: UID of the participant currently typing, or empty string.

typingUpdatedAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when typing state was last updated.

mutedByUids.description: Bounded 0-2 element array of UIDs that muted notifications for this thread.

blockedByUid.description: UID of the participant who blocked this thread, or empty string.

reportedByUid.description: UID of the participant who reported abusive behavior in this thread, or empty string.

reportReason.description: Reason provided when reporting abusive user, or empty string.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview of the most recent message.

lastMessageAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds of the most recent message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: Individual chat message in a transaction or party thread (text, quick reply, payment proof, system audit event, or extension request).

senderName.description: Display name of the message sender.

participantUids.description: Denormalized 1-2 participant UIDs for two-party read/query isolation.

attachmentUri.description: Optional URI or reference for payment-proof image or PDF.

attachmentMimeType.description: MIME type of payment proof (e.g., image/jpeg, application/pdf).

deliveryStatus.description: Delivery and read receipt tick status.

proposedDueDateMillis.description: Proposed new due date in epoch milliseconds when messageType is EXTENSION_REQUEST, else -1.

extensionStatus.description: Resolution status for due date extension requests.

readAtMillis.description: Epoch milliseconds when read by counterparty, or -1.

/user_profiles/{userId}.description: Owner-isolated user profile and payment details.

/shared_records/{remoteId}.description: Two-party verification records readable only by creatorUid and counterpartyUid.

/shared_records/{remoteId}/partial_payme.description: Partial repayments and counterparty acknowledgements for a shared record.

/shared_records/{remoteId}/audit_trail/{.description: Immutable append-only audit trail for a shared record.

/chat_threads/{threadId}.description: Two-party chat thread per transaction or party with typing indicator, mute, block, and report controls.

/chat_threads/{threadId}/messages/{messa.description: Messages, quick replies, payment proofs, audit events, and extension requests inside a chat thread.
